tailoring.headline: Senior SAP Commerce Cloud Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms like SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris). Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, Docker and Kubernetes, production troubleshooting, Git, code reviews and agile teams. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior Consultant | SAP CX (all genders)
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Senior Consultant | SAP CX position at cronos Unternehmensberatung GmbH. With over 5 years of professional experience specializing in SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) development and enterprise integrations at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am eager to bring my technical expertise to your customer experience projects.

bullets.label: Enterprise SAP & Integration Experience
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) and developed OCC REST Web Services for headless architectures and third-party consumers.

bullets.label: System & Data Integration
bullets.text: Investigated and resolved integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM and Profisee platforms, and built data pipelines using Hotfolders and DataHub to keep product catalogs synchronized.

bullets.label: Consultative & Technical Leadership
bullets.text: Acted in international technical environments, performing code reviews, supporting production issues, and providing technical guidance to junior developers.

bullets.label: Agile Delivery & Quality Assurance
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) within agile DevOps workflows, maintaining high code quality standards.

cover_en.gap: While my core expertise lies heavily in SAP Commerce Cloud rather than SAP Sales Cloud, SAP Service Cloud, or custom SAP BTP web applications, I am very keen to learn these specific platforms and expand my skill set into new areas.
cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit, I am currently serving a notice period ending on 15 December 2026, and will be available to start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my background aligns with your needs in an interview.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als Senior Consultant | SAP CX (all genders)
cover_de.hook: Mit großem Interesse habe ich Ihre Ausschreibung für die Position als Senior Consultant | SAP CX bei der cronos Unternehmensberatung GmbH gelesen. Als Backend-Entwicklerin mit über 5 Jahren Berufserfahrung im Aufbau und der Betreuung von SAP Commerce Cloud Plattformen (Hybris) bei Rockwell Automation und Shell bringe ich fundierte SAP- und Integrationserfahrung mit.

bullets.label: SAP-Plattformen & Webdienste
bullets.text: Entwicklung und Implementierung von Backend- und Frontend-Funktionalitäten auf SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) sowie Erstellung von OCC REST Web Services.

bullets.label: Schnittstellen & Datenintegration
bullets.text: Investigation und Behebung von Integrationsengpässen zwischen SAP ERP, MDM und Profisee Plattformen sowie Aufbau von PIM-zu-Hybris Datenpipelines.

bullets.label: DevOps & Deployment
bullets.text: Ausführung von CI/CD-Deployment-Zyklen und Release-Builds auf SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) in agilen DevOps-Workflows.

bullets.label: Technische Führung
bullets.text: Durchführung von Code Reviews, Unterstützung bei der Fehlerbehebung in der Produktion und technische Anleitung von Nachwuchsentwicklern.

cover_de.gap: Zwar liegt mein Schwerpunkt auf SAP Commerce Cloud und nicht auf SAP Sales Cloud, SAP Service Cloud oder der SAP BTP, jedoch verfüge ich über fundierte SAP-Erfahrung und bin hochmotiviert, mich in diese neuen Themenbereiche einzuarbeiten.
cover_de.logistics: Ich wohne in Karlsruhe, besitze eine gültige deutsche Aufenthalts- und Arbeitserlaubnis und befinde mich in einer Kündigungsfrist bis zum 15.12.2026, sodass ich ab dem 16.12.2026 zur Verfügung stehe. Über ein Gespräch freue ich mich sehr.

tailoring.why_company: I want to work at cronos Unternehmensberatung GmbH because of your 30-year leadership in digital innovation and IT consulting for the energy sector and beyond. I am eager to apply my 5+ years of enterprise SAP Commerce experience to your Customer Experience projects while growing into new SAP solution areas.
tailoring.motivation_short: I am motivated to contribute my 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud expertise to cronos's CX projects, support digital transformations, and continuously learn new SAP technologies.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! With 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am very interested in the Senior Consultant SAP CX role at cronos. I hold a valid work permit and can start on 16.12.2026. Let's connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Senior Consultant | SAP CX - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my application documents, including my CV and cover letter, for the Senior Consultant | SAP CX position at cronos Unternehmensberatung GmbH.

With over 5 years of professional experience in SAP Commerce Cloud development, REST APIs, and enterprise system integrations, I am eager to bring my technical background to your team. I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid work permit, and am available starting 16 December 2026.

I look forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
